description: This file defines an internal struct 'CapacityPartition' used for partitioning cache capacity into hot, warm, and cold segments, favoring frequently accessed items by allocating 80% to warm queue.

classes.name: CapacityPartition
classes.description: An internal readonly struct that manages cache capacity partitioning into hot, warm, and cold segments based on specified ratios.

methods.name: CapacityPartition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes capacity partitioning with total capacity and default warm ratio.

methods.name: CapacityPartition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes capacity partitioning with total capacity and specified warm ratio.

methods.name: ComputeQueueCapacity
methods.description: Private static method that calculates the number of hot, warm, and cold items based on total capacity and warm ratio.
